```python
import numpy as np
def update_edge_distance(edge_distance, local_opt_tour, edge_n_used):
    updated_edge_distance = np.copy(edge_distance)
    u_idx = local_opt_tour
    v_idx = np.roll(local_opt_tour, -1)
    tour_lengths = edge_distance[u_idx, v_idx]
    tour_counts = edge_n_used[u_idx, v_idx]
    utilities = tour_lengths / (1.0 + tour_counts)
    max_utility = np.max(utilities)
    avg_edge = np.mean(tour_lengths)
    penalty = 0.3 * avg_edge
    threshold = 0.99 * max_utility
    selected_mask = utilities >= threshold
    sel_u = u_idx[selected_mask]
    sel_v = v_idx[selected_mask]
    updated_edge_distance[sel_u, sel_v] += penalty
    updated_edge_distance[sel_v, sel_u] += penalty
    return updated_edge_distance
```

```python
        if utilities[idx] >= threshold:
            edge_n_used[u, v] += 1
            updated_edge_distance[u, v] += lambda_factor / (1.0 + edge_n_used[u, v])
    return updated_edge_distance
```

import numpy as np
def update_edge_distance(edge_distance, local_opt_tour, edge_n_used):
    updated_edge_distance = np.copy(edge_distance)
    n = len(local_opt_tour)
    edge_utilities = np.zeros(n)
    tour_edges = []
    for i in range(n):
        u = local_opt_tour[i]
        v = local_opt_tour[(i + 1) % n]
        tour_edges.append((u, v))
        edge_utilities[i] = edge_distance[u, v] / (1.0 + edge_n_used[u, v])
    segment_utilities = np.zeros(n)
    for i in range(n):
        next_i = (i + 1) % n
        segment_utilities[i] = edge_utilities[i] + edge_utilities[next_i]
    max_util = np.max(segment_utilities)
    if max_util <= 0:
        return updated_edge_distance
    avg_dist = np.mean(edge_distance)
    lambda_param = 0.3 * (avg_dist / n)
    threshold = 0.999 * max_util
    for i in range(n):
        if segment_utilities[i] >= threshold:
            u1, v1 = tour_edges[i]
            next_i = (i + 1) % n
            u2, v2 = tour_edges[next_i]
            updated_edge_distance[u1, v1] += lambda_param
            updated_edge_distance[v1, u1] += lambda_param
            edge_n_used[u1, v1] += 1
            edge_n_used[v1, u1] += 1
            updated_edge_distance[u2, v2] += lambda_param
            updated_edge_distance[v2, u2] += lambda_param
            edge_n_used[u2, v2] += 1
            edge_n_used[v2, u2] += 1
    return updated_edge_distance

import numpy as np

def update_edge_distance(edge_distance, local_opt_tour, edge_n_used):
    updated_edge_distance = np.copy(edge_distance)
    n = len(local_opt_tour)
    
    u_idx = local_opt_tour
    v_idx = np.roll(local_opt_tour, -1)
    
    tour_lengths = edge_distance[u_idx, v_idx]
    tour_counts = edge_n_used[u_idx, v_idx]
    
    edge_utilities = tour_lengths / (1.0 + tour_counts)
    segment_utilities = edge_utilities + np.roll(edge_utilities, -1)
    
    max_utility = np.max(segment_utilities)
    if max_utility <= 0:
        return updated_edge_distance
    
    avg_tour_edge = np.mean(tour_lengths)
    penalty = 0.3 * avg_tour_edge
    threshold = 0.99 * max_utility
    
    selected_segments = np.where(segment_utilities >= threshold)[0]
    
    penalize_mask = np.zeros(n, dtype=bool)
    penalize_mask[selected_segments] = True
    penalize_mask[(selected_segments + 1) % n] = True
    
    sel_u = u_idx[penalize_mask]
    sel_v = v_idx[penalize_mask]
    
    updated_edge_distance[sel_u, sel_v] += penalty
